name: anki-kashikoi-mcp
description: Intelligent Anki flashcard management with direct field mapping
long_description: A Desktop Extension (DXT) for intelligent Anki flashcard management. This MCP server provides direct field mapping capabilities by analyzing existing decks and allowing users to add flashcards using actual field names. Features include deck analysis, auto-configuration, and multi-note type support with persistent configuration storage.

tools.name: analyze_deck
tools.description: Analyze a deck and save its configuration

tools.name: add_card
tools.description: Add a card to Anki using field names directly

tools.name: set_default_deck
tools.description: Set the default deck for adding cards
